short_answer: Kevin Thomas is a handicapper who sells picks on Tony's Picks, a marketplace run by Tony Tellez that lists about 29 cappers. His profile says he served four years in the Navy and went to college to teach math, and that he handicaps the NFL, MLB, WNBA, NBA, college football, college basketball and the NHL. He also writes free pick articles on the Tony's Picks blog. In that narrow sense he is a real, active seller.

Whether his picks make money is less clear. In late June and early July 2026 the Tony's Picks blog called him the top performer of the past 30 days, at 50-28-1. But the record the same marketplace showed for his whole history on 16 Nov 2026 was 1366 wins, 1388 losses and 46 pushes, just under half, with unit totals below zero for his whole history, for 2026 so far and for 2025.

Treat him as a seller with one very good month and a long record that, by the marketplace's own numbers, does not show a profit. If you buy, buy short, log each pick yourself with the line you got, and do not judge him by a 30 day leaderboard.

guarantee: In the Tony's Picks store data, only his $30 single game packages are flagged as guaranteed, and the guaranteed price is the same $30. We could not find a page that explains what that guarantee gives a buyer, such as cash back, store credit or a free pick. Ask before you rely on it.

The Tony's Picks terms page deals with auto renewing memberships. It says a buyer must email within 3 days of the next automatic renewal date to stop it and get a refund or credit for that period, and that a 3 day trial must be cancelled 48 hours before it renews. Nothing we read covers losses on the bets themselves, which are usually far larger than the package price.

claims_note: The leaderboard posts and the long run record point in different directions. The June and July 2026 blog posts were written by the owner of the marketplace that sells his picks, and they cover one 30 day window. The lifetime numbers in the same marketplace's data show slightly more losses than wins.

The unit figures on Tony's Picks use a scale the site does not explain. A 50-28-1 month showed as +2246 units, which looks closer to dollars won on $100 bets than to standard units. We report the numbers as the site shows them and have not confirmed the scale.
record: What a buyer can verify independently: nothing that we could find. We found no third party tracker, contest result or full archive of his picks outside the marketplace that sells them.

What the marketplace shows: on 16 Nov 2026 the Tony's Picks data for his profile listed 1366 wins, 1388 losses and 46 pushes, a lifetime units figure of minus 9322, minus 3345 for this year and minus 2512 for last year. The same data showed minus 1283 for the last 30 days and minus 612 for the last 7 days. These numbers are graded by the seller's own marketplace, not audited.
His free picks appear as articles on the Tony's Picks blog, such as an under 44.5 in Bills at Vikings for 9 Nov 2026. The articles we opened did not show a running record of the free plays.

our_data.text: Watchdog grades picks captured from public posts before the game starts. In this edition no Kevin Thomas pick history is matched to a Watchdog graded record, so we make no claim about how Kevin Thomas performs.
our_data.context: For scale: the lifetime record Tony's Picks shows for him works out to about 49.6% winners, while the 30 day run its blog promoted in July 2026 was about 64%. On the Watchdog board, {{over60}} of {{established}} established accounts (100 or more graded picks) were at 60% or better, and the median established account won {{median_win}}% of its picks. At standard -110 odds a bettor needs about 52.4% to break even.

customers_intro: We found no independent buyer reviews of Kevin Thomas. Below is what we searched and what little exists.

customers.text: We found no posts from people who say they bought Kevin Thomas picks, good or bad. Searches of four betting subreddits through the Reddit archive, and web searches for forum threads, review pages and complaints, returned nothing about him. What exists online is his own free pick articles and the Tony's Picks blog praising one strong month in June 2026. His name also shows up in reposted pick lists on X from accounts that collect plays from many sellers, which says nothing about how buyers fared.

The Tony's Picks blog ranked him first over the past 30 days at 49-31-1 and said he was nearly 800 units ahead of second place. The post was written by the marketplace owner, so it is not independent evidence.
A follow up post again put him at the top of the 30 day board, at 50-28-1 for +2246 units. Same author, same marketplace.
No Reddit, Covers, Sportsbook Review or TheRX thread about Kevin Thomas the handicapper turned up in our searches, and we found no review page, regulator action or court record naming him.

conflicts: Every record and ranking we saw comes from Tony's Picks, the marketplace that earns money when his packages sell. Its blog posts about him are marketing.
The marketplace's own data contradicts the blog's message: a top month in June 2026, but losing unit totals for 2025, for 2026 so far, and over his whole history there.
strengths: Prices for every package are listed, from $30 for one game upward.
He writes free pick articles with his reasoning, so you can judge his thinking before paying.
The marketplace shows a lifetime win and loss count instead of only hot streaks.
concerns: The lifetime record the marketplace shows is below 50% winners with negative units.
Praise comes only from the marketplace that sells his picks.
The guarantee on single game packages is not explained anywhere we could find, and the bigger packages have none.
The three day pass description says $89.99 while the listed price is $109.
No independent buyer reviews at all.
checklist: Ask for every pick from the last 12 months with the line, the odds and the time it was sent. A 30 day leaderboard is not a record.
Count units, not wins. A 60% month can sit inside a losing year.
Read the guarantee for the words refund, credit and extension before you pay for it.
Watch automatic renewals. Tony's Picks wants a cancellation email days before the renewal date.
Write down each pick yourself the moment you receive it, with the line you can actually get.
faq: He is a real handicapper with an active profile, published prices and free pick articles on Tony's Picks. We could not verify that his picks win over time. The marketplace's own data showed a lifetime record just under 50% with negative units, and we found no independent buyer reviews and no court or regulator action involving him.
How much does Kevin Thomas cost?
On 16 Nov 2026 Tony's Picks listed single game packages at $30, a three day pass at $109, 30 days at $349, a college football season pass at $899.99 and an NFL season pass at $999.99.
Does Kevin Thomas have a verified record?
No. The only record is the one Tony's Picks keeps: 1366 wins, 1388 losses and 46 pushes on 16 Nov 2026. It is graded by the marketplace that sells his picks, not by an outside party.

He had a strong month in June 2026, but the marketplace's longer numbers show losses for 2025 and for 2026 so far. Nothing refunds your betting losses, so if you try him, buy the shortest package and track every pick yourself.
